jobs.description:
Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.
• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.
• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

We guarantee that you won’t be bored
 

As a process operator, you have several responsibilities: 
 
 

• You will receive an intensive training before coordinating and operating high-end devices in the clean room. 

• You organize your own workload according to defined goals. 

• You are responsible for the quality of your own processing. 

• You perform quality tests meticulously. 

• You accurately report problems to our engineers.  

• You have a keen eye for safety and operational efficiency. 

• You suggest improvements.  

Who are we looking for?
 

Well, an enthusiastic personality and a passion for technology already go a long way. You are hands-on, full of expectation and eager to prove yourself. You enjoy working in a team, are accurate, dare to take initiative and are not afraid of asking questions. You have fluent communication skills in English. You are not looking for a typical nine-to-five and you see the advantages of working in shifts every now and again — handsome bonusses and lots of quality time on your hands while others are ‘insanely busy’. An example of our shift regime:
 
 

• Week X: You will work the early shift from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+1: You work the night shift from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+2: You work the late shift from Monday to Wednesday, on Thursday and Friday you have recuperation and on Saturday and Sunday you work 12h. 

• Week X+3: From Monday to Wednesday you have recuperation and on Thursday and Friday you work in the late shift. 

• Week X: You work from Monday to Friday in the early shift.

Comecer is expanding its international Service Team! To strengthen our team in Belgium, we are looking for 
Field Service Engineers, preferably based in the 
Brussels–Leuven region. You will be employed by Orise NV 
(former Process Automation Solutions), based in Belgium, and part of ATS Corporation, while working closely with Comecer Netherlands BV and the wider Comecer team.
 

In this role, you will help install, maintain and support high-tech systems that play a critical role in the (radio)pharmaceutical and nuclear medicine sectors.
 

Comecer’s solutions are developed and manufactured in Joure (The Netherlands) and are used in complex laboratory environments worldwide.
 

 
 

What you will do
 

In this role, you will be 
responsible for installing, servicing, and maintaining Comecer equipment at customer sites throughout Belgium. You will carry out both preventive and corrective maintenance, ensuring that each system performs optimally and meets all operational requirements. In addition, you will provide 
training and technical support to end users, helping them understand and operate the equipment effectively. Throughout every assignment, you will communicate clearly and professionally with customers and internal teams, representing Comecer as a trusted, solution-oriented technical expert.

What you bring
 

You bring hands‑on experience in repairing technical equipment and troubleshooting both mechanical and electrical issues. You are able to read and interpret electrical, pneumatic and mechanical drawings, and you have a background in electronics, electromechanics or mechanical engineering. In this role, strong communication skills and a customer‑focused attitude are essential, along with a willingness to travel within Belgium and occasionally abroad. You have an energetic, proactive and solution‑driven mindset.
 

Requirements:
 
 

• Technical degree at secondary or bachelor level (electromechanics, electronics or mechatronics). 

• Strong English and French skills; Dutch is an advantage. 

• Experience with PLC-controlled systems is considered as a plus. 

• Valid category B driving licence.

jobs.occupation: Order picker in night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in order picking or logistics? Are you looking for a physically challenging role with job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a stable and growing transport company in Oostkamp that specializes in frozen food logistics, we're looking for an order picker to join the team in the freezer in the night shift. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an order picker, you're the corner stone of the company's logistical processes. You work in the freezer every night to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Feel at your absolute best at night and are looking for a night job
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

jobs.occupation: IT & Cyber Risk Specialist – HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
Your Job at a glance

Ready to Shape the Future of Cybersecurity in Banking?

At the heart of BNP Paribas Fortis, the Centre of Expertise Security (CoE Security) drives innovation in secure solutions, designing, implementing, and maintaining trusted, cutting-edge protections for our teams and clients.

As an IT Cyber Risk Manager, you will operate at the core of our cybersecurity strategy, connecting, influencing, and collaborating across the entire bank. Within our ‘Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC)’ team, you will work closely with IT and Business Units to redefine Operational Risk Management, with a sharp focus on IT and Cyber Security.

This is not just a risk management role - it’s an opportunity to:

• Engage diverse stakeholders, from technical teams to C-level executives, across all areas of BNP Paribas Fortis.
• Drive creative solutions, transforming complex cyber risks into practical, forward-thinking strategies.
• Shape a resilient future by proactively managing cyber risks to strengthen the bank’s defenses.
If you thrive in a dynamic, cross-functional environment where innovation and collaboration are key, this is your chance to make a tangible impact in banking cybersecurity

 

And in detail

Your Key Role as IT & Cyber Risk Specialist :

You serve as the critical link between technical risks, business priorities, and strategic decisions, ensuring IT and cybersecurity risks are proactively identified, analyzed, and translated into actionable strategies—fully aligned with the bank’s objectives.

Why this role stands out:

• Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Tribes, Functions, and Business Units, clearly articulating risks to both technical teams and leadership—enabling data-driven decision-making.
• Proactive risk intelligence: From Shadow IT exposures to operational vulnerabilities, you assess, prioritize, and drive mitigation, delivering practical solutions that balance security with business continuity.
• Strategic advisory: Provide targeted recommendations to IT and business stakeholders, ensuring risks are managed without compromising operational goals.
• Enterprise-wide alignment: Report risks, trends, and insights to Cyber Security, IT, and Business Management, while sharing best practices across the BNP Paribas Group—reinforcing a unified risk posture.
• Process optimization: Leverage your expertise to refine risk management methods and tools, ensuring they remain efficient, scalable, and future-ready."

Your talents and skills

• Risk-to-Solution Mindset: You break down complex IT and cybersecurity challenges, turning them into clear, actionable insights for leadership—viewing risks as solvable challenges, not just warnings.
• Bank-Specific Acumen: Deep understanding of BNP Paribas Fortis’ businesses, functions, and strategic goals, ensuring risk management aligns with our priorities.
• Technical + Risk Expertise: Hands-on experience in IT infrastructure, architecture, and security, blending technical knowledge with risk awareness to design practical solutions—not just identify risks.
• Multilingual Communication: Fluent in French or Dutch + professional English, with strong written and verbal persuasion skills. You adapt seamlessly between IT, business, and management discussions.
• Practical Framework Application: Proven ability to operationalize IT processes, Cyber Security Management Systems, and control frameworks—ensuring they deliver in practice.
• Certifications & Methodologies: CISSP, CISM, Operational Risk Management, or Agile experience are a plus, but not mandatory.

jobs.occupation: Business Analyst IAM - IT Production Security - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

You’ll be the go-to expert in Privileged Access Management (PAM) within our IAM Evolution Squad, driving the security and efficiency of access governance at BNP Paribas Fortis. 

Your mission? Design, implement, and optimize PAM solutions using CyberArk and SailPoint, ensuring compliance with strict banking regulations while collaborating with IT, security, and business teams.

This is your chance to shape the future of secure access in a global bank, working in a hybrid setup (50% remote, 50% on-site in Brussels) with a skilled, multicultural team of 10 specialists.

 

AND IN DETAIL

What You’ll Own:

• Lead PAM Strategy & Execution: As the Privileged Access Management (PAM) Subject Matter Expert (SME), you’ll own the design, implementation, and optimization of CyberArk-based solutions, ensuring they meet security, compliance, and operational needs.
• Strengthen Access Governance: Work closely with IAM, IT Security, Compliance, and Risk teams to align access policies with BNP Paribas Fortis standards and regulatory requirements.
• Drive Process Improvement: Use KPIs and data-driven insights to refine access management workflows, reducing risks and enhancing efficiency.
• Collaborate & Train: Partner with cross-functional teams to implement best practices and upskill colleagues on PAM and IAM protocols.
• Innovate with Cutting-Edge Tools: Leverage SailPoint, CyberArk, and ServiceNow to build a scalable, adaptive identity framework.
 

Why It Matters:  You’re not just managing access, you’re protecting critical banking systems, ensuring compliance, and enabling secure, seamless operations for thousands of users. 

Your work will directly impact how we mitigate risks, enforce policies, and future-proof our security infrastructure.

Your Team & Environment:

• A squad of 10 (Business Analysts, Security Officers, Product Owner, Scrum Master) based in Montagne-Du-Parc, Brussels.
• A hybrid work model (50% remote, 50% on-site) for flexibility and collaboration.
• A culture of innovation, where you’ll help transition access governance into a dynamic, compliance-first, AI-augmented capability.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

Non-Negotiables (Must-Haves)

• 10+ years in security technology, with deep expertise in:
• Identity & Access Management (IAM)
• Privileged Access Management (PAM), CyberArk experience mandatory
• Segregation of Duties (SoD) & Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) 
• Hands-on experience with:
• SailPoint, Cloud (IaaS/PaaS), ServiceNow, Process Management Tools
• Designing requirements, specifications, and use cases 
• CISSP Certification (or equivalent) 
• Languages:
• English (fluent, written & spoken)
• Dutch and/or French is an asset
 

What Sets You Apart

• Analytical & Conceptual Thinker: You break down complex problems and design practical, scalable solutions. 
• Strong Negotiator & Influencer : You align stakeholders, drive decisions, and get buy-in for critical security initiatives.
• Proactive & Resilient: You take ownership, adapt quickly, and deliver under pressure.
• Strict on Execution: You track progress meticulously and ensure no detail is overlooked
• Team Player in a Multicultural Setting: You collaborate smoothly with diverse, high-performing teams.

jobs.occupation: Web Content Management Engineer - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

The Agile Production Services (APS) tribe is where IT Production happens. As part of a tight-knit group of 7 teams, we handle end-to-end Production Services, from go-live support to 24/7 on-call troubleshooting (yes, nights and weekends included).

Your role? The tech backbone of our digital operations. Whether it’s Level 2/3 support, application security, or hosting optimization, you’ll work closely with Infrastructure and Dev teams to keep our systems fast, secure, and reliable. No two days are the same - and that’s the way we like it.

AND IN DETAIL

As our WCM Specialist, you’ll be the go-to person for all things Web Content Management. 

That means:

• Ownership of WCM expertise: you’ll be the resident guru on TeamSite, headless architecture, and best practices. When teams need answers, they come to you.
• Building, integrating, improving: you’ll analyze, develop, or implement new components, working with Application Leads and integrators to push boundaries. 
• Keeping the Portal running smoothly: but not just maintaining it. You’ll help shape the future vision in our WCM guild (our tech community).
• Documentation that actually helps: you’ll turn complex setups into clear, actionable guides for stakeholders. No jargon-heavy manuals.
• Collaborating with architects: you’ll assist in cost-benefit analyses for new web implementations. 
• Security and performance first: you’ll play an active role in incident, problem, and change management. Finding issues, fixing them, preventing repeats.
• Setting standards: you’ll ensure every user, on every device, has a seamless experience.
• Monitoring and optimizing: you’ll track performance, spot bottlenecks, and keep things running at peak efficiency.
• On-call duty: One week per month (18:00–7:30), you’re the go-to person. But don’t worry: you’re never alone.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

What you bring:

• 5+ years of experience.
• OpenText mastery: you know TeamSite, LiveSite, OpenDeploy inside out, in an Agile/XP environment.
• Your tech toolkit:
• JavaScript, Node.js, NPM, React, Webpack, Jest, SASS, HTML5 are your daily drivers.
• CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Nexus). You automate like it’s second nature.
• Headless WCM architecture (especially TeamSite). You don’t just understand it, you make it work.
• Sharp analytical skills. You spot problems before they happen.
 

How you work:

• Team player, but self-driven: you take initiative and own your work.
• Fast learner: new tools? You pick them up quickly and put them to use.
• Open-minded and adaptable: change is the only constant in tech, and you thrive in it.
• Detail-oriented, but big-picture aware: you follow processes without losing sight of the end goal.
• Clear communicator: whether it’s tech talk with devs or updates for management, you get your point across.
• Persistent and committed: you don’t quit until the job’s done right.
• Comfortable in a multicultural environment: different backgrounds, one shared mission.
 

Languages:

• Fluent English (written and spoken) is a must.
• Dutch and/or French? A definite plus.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

The Data department builds and maintains both future-ready and traditional data platforms, tools, and services to ensure easy, secure data access. It empowers data consumers with self-service capabilities while upholding governance and quality standards.

The department delivers scalable, compliant, and user-centric data solutions to meet business needs. Within this framework, the Tribe designs and implements structured, optimized data stores for APIs, reporting, and analytics. They ensure compliance, security, and governance of data assets through modern data management practices, supported by high-quality documentation and tooling. Their mission is to enable reliable, scalable, and well-governed data consumption across the organization.

At BNP Paribas Fortis, you will contribute to innovation by designing advanced data pipelines and infrastructure that power AI, real-time analytics, and strategic decision-making as part of our digital transformation. 

As a Data Engineer, you will address challenges such as scalability, latency, and compliance, ensuring secure, high-quality data flows while collaborating in Agile teams. Your work will unlock data-driven insights, combining technical excellence with regulatory requirements to shape the bank’s future.

The Tribe Data Services comprises over 160 colleagues, organized into more than 10 squads, primarily based in Brussels, with some team members working nearshore or offshore.

AND IN DETAIL

As a Functional Data Engineer, you will:

• Build and maintain optimized data stores by designing, developing, and ensuring well-structured, high-performance data assets (e.g., databases) tailored for APIs, reporting, analytics, and BI tools.
• Enable data-driven decision-making by delivering reliable, accurate, and accessible data for business intelligence, reporting, and analysis services while maintaining related infrastructure.
• Collaborate with internal clients and teams as a trusted partner, understanding stakeholder needs, guiding them on data solutions, and working cross-functionally while adhering to Tribe methodologies and standards.
• Ensure compliance and risk management by strictly following data protection regulations (e.g., GDPR) and banking security policies, mitigating risks in data collection, processing, and storage to safeguard client and institutional data.
• Drive continuous improvement by proactively identifying opportunities to enhance data quality, efficiency, and innovation—whether through new tools, automation, or process optimizations—while aligning with business and regulatory requirements.
• Collect the data from the source and design it into models that will be used by developers.  In this role you are the bridge between the business needs and the developers. You translate requests into models that will be interpreted by the developers.
• Uphold data quality and governance by implementing validation rules, monitoring, and metadata management to maintain accuracy, consistency, and compliance.
• Support stakeholders and troubleshoot issues by resolving data incidents (e.g., broken pipelines, latency problems) and partnering with analysts, product owners, or business teams to translate requirements into technical solutions—such as creating self-service datasets or optimizing queries for reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

• Education and experience:
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT or engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
• Equivalent experience: minimum 3 years.  
• Hard skills:
• Working experience with databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL.
• Knowledge of SQL, including writing complex queries and performance tuning.
• Profound Knowledge of data warehouse (DWH) modeling (e.g., Kimball, Inmon, Data Vault).
• Understanding or knowledge of ETL tools like Informatica PowerCenter.
• Understanding of Big Data technologies such as Spark, Astronomer.
• Extended knowledge of PowerDesigner tool (or equivalent)  
• Soft skills:
• Problem-solving mindset: ability to troubleshoot complex data issues and propose scalable solutions.
• Collaboration: strong team player with experience in cross-functional Agile teams.
• Ownership and accountability: takes responsibility for data quality, delivery timelines, and system reliability.
• Communication: ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
• Continuous learning: stays updated on emerging data technologies.  
• Languages:
• You communicate fluently in English; knowledge of French and/or Dutch is an asset.

As a Business Enterprise Architect, you will occupy a key position, crucial to growing our advisory agency within the utilities sector. You will play a significant role in expanding our Industry and Services market, and in executing our strategy to become the preferred digital business partner of our clients by 2026. • 
Create and implement innovative architectural strategies to increase our market share in the Utilities sector, with a focus on digital transformation and sustainability.

• Fluent in Dutch and English; French is a plus.
• Proven track record in digital transformation initiatives, particularly in the energy sector and or water management projects.
• Strong understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks and digital themes specific to utilities (e.g., Smart Grid, Energy Transition, Water Management Systems).
• Professional network in the Utilities sector.
• Excellent communication skills, able to articulate complex concepts to diverse stakeholders.
• Strategic mindset with the ability to bridge business strategy and technical implementation.
• Passion for innovative technology solutions in utilities, especially in areas of sustainability and resource efficiency.
